scripts.instructions:
node -e "console.log('
=== MOBILE APP (EXPO) INSTRUCTIONS ===

  npm run start             Start Expo dev server (local LAN - phone must be on same Wi-Fi)
  npm run tunnel            Start Expo with tunnel (connect from ANY network / cellular / remote)
  npm run start:tunnel      Alias for npm run tunnel
  npm run android           Launch directly on connected Android device or emulator
  npm run android:tunnel    Launch on Android device with tunnel enabled
  npm run ios               Launch on iOS simulator
  npm run web               Launch in web browser mode
  npm run app-version       Show the app version (1.0.<commit count>)
  npm run build:apk         Build the Android APK on EAS with that version
  npm run test:agent        Run automated Android emulator + local AI agent test suite
  npm run test:agent:ui     Launch interactive Web Test Studio dashboard
  npm run test:agent:watch  Run mobile agent tests in live watch mode
')"
